name: siva-rudra-foundation-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Siva Rudra Foundation Event Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "public,admin,judges,stage,contest,api" -c "black.bgYellow,yellow.bgBlack,white.bgBlack,cyan.bgBlack,magenta.bgBlack,blue.bgBlack" "npm run dev --workspace=@srf/public" "npm run dev --workspace=@srf/admin" "npm run dev --workspace=@srf/judges" "npm run dev --workspace=@srf/stage" "npm run dev --workspace=@srf/contestant" "npm run start --workspace=@srf/api"
